description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Poison 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Hollow Beauty] to the user

description.name: Attach Poison 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Hollow Beauty
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using a Poison ability
